decisions.reason: As a software product with explicit public presentation and strong fit to the firm's connected, data-driven infrastructure strategy, prior development effort and strategic commitment make management likely to continue it.

Although this hardware product is less central to the firm's digital direction, it extends the established water-infrastructure portfolio and the invested engineering effort supports continued commitment.
Control technology for water engineering machinery is close to the firm's core integrated offering and supports more connected operations, so sunk development costs and strategic fit favor retention.

This newer software-and-automation product was prominently presented and matches the firm's announced move toward web-based, secure, data-driven infrastructure management, which makes withdrawal unlikely.
